description: This file sets up and runs a conversational bot using Pipecat framework, integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and language model services, with specific focus on Deepgram and OpenAI APIs, and includes transport configuration and event handling.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates the pipeline execution with parameters and timeout.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of the pipeline, including signal handling.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the context for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs the context with user and assistant response aggregators.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy for stopping user turns based on analysis.

classes.name: UserTurnStrategies
classes.description: Defines strategies for user turn handling.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts processing.
